data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_faith_lst_191)
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, your animal companion develops greater combat prowess, mental acumen, and protection against natural elements. First, your animal companion gains a +1 bonus to its Intelligence and Wisdom scores. Second, your animal companion gains a +2 sacred or profane bonus on attack and damage rolls. Third, your animal companion gains a +4 sacred or profane bonus on all saving throws against cold, electricity, and fire spells and effects. If you don't have an animal companion, you instead gain the ability to use summon nature's ally VII as a spell-like ability once per day.
